comments.text: I spent a month in Saigon and I really loved it. The one exception was Ben Thanh Market, which I absolutely hated. I was assaulted by a woman vendor in there because I didn't want to pay 90 dollars for 4 shirts. The vendors didn't want to haggle at all. I much prefer central market, which had ac and vendors were actually willing to haggle. You would have gotten your glasses for around 5 dollars at Central Market. Besides one bad experience at the market and with a shoe cleaner guy, Saigon was fantastic and I will definitely go back some time.
